The [[Yuzzum]] [[Gender|male]] '''Wam Lufba''', nicknamed "'''Bam'''," was born on the [[moon]] of [[Endor]], but left on a visiting [[starship]]. He ended up being shanghaied into working as a pest exterminator at the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].

Lufba was present in Jabba's [[throne]] room in [[4 ABY]] during a performance by the [[Max Rebo Band]] and witnessed the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] being dropped into Jabba's [[rancor]] pit. The Yuzzum then witnessed [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]], negotiate with the Hutt over the [[bounty]] on the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]].

==Biography==
===Tricked into service===
Wam Lufba, who also went by the nicknamed "Bam," was a [[Yuzzum]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Force Collection" /> from the [[Endor|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)|Endor]]. Lufba left the [[moon]] on a visiting [[starship]] and ended up on the [[desert]] planet [[Tatooine]] where the Yuzzum<ref name="USW" /> was tricked into [[Jabba's criminal empire|working]] as a pest exterminator<ref name="Force Collection" /> at the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The pests that Lufba had to deal with could be quite dangerous,<ref name="USW" /> but the perceived innocuousness of the Yuzzum allowed him to overhear the various machinations of the lowlifes that made up Jabba's court without arousing suspicion.<ref name="Force Collection" />

===Failure to back Fortuna===
{{Quote|You know who I am. ''Boba Fett''. You know what that means. All of you want to live. Who doesn't? But I promise. Fight me… some of you die. Maybe ''most'' of you. And you'd be dying… for ''him''. Doesn't seem fair, does it?|Boba Fett convinces Wam Lufba and others not to stand in his way|<ref name="WotBH 1">[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:BobaVsFortuna2-WOTBH1.png|thumb|right|300px|Wam Lufba thought better of backing Bib Fortuna after a warning from Fett.]]
In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] received custody of the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] after Solo was frozen in [[carbonite]]. As Jabba had placed an outstanding [[bounty]] on the smuggler head, Fett promised to deliver him to the Hutt, but before he could fulfil this agreement, the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate stole Solo. After learning of this, Jabba put a bounty on Fett's head, so the bounty hunter traveled to Jabba's Palace to confront the Hutt. Fett was greeted at the entrance to the palace by the Hutt's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]].<ref name="WotBH 1" />

After Fortuna informed Fett that Jabba was not available as he was attending the Crimson Dawn's [[Auction for Han Solo|auction for Solo]], Wam Lufba and a crowd made up of other members of the Hutt's court emerged behind the majordomo. The group aimed their weapons at Fett as Fortuna suggested that Fett leave, but the bounty hunter instead reminded Lufba and the others of his deadly reputation. When faced with the reality of potentially dying only for the sake of Fortuna, Lufa and the others silently lowered their weapons. Fett then moved through the crowd with Fortuna to see the invitation.<ref name="WotBH 1" />

===End of employment===
[[File:DustBunnyWithAGun-ROTJ.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Wam Lufba worked in Jabba's Palace.]]
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> Lufba was stood beside Jabba's [[throne]] in the palace during a performance of the [[Music|song]] "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]]. When the Hutt demanded that they repeat the song, the Yuzzum danced along to the second performance until it was interrupted by Jabba, who dropped the [[Slavery|enslaved]] dancer [[Oola]] into a pit below the throne room after she refused his advances. The court then crowded round to watch as Oola was eaten by Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

Once the spectacle was over, the court's attention was drawn to the room's entry way by the sound of [[blaster]] fire. The source was revealed to be [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], disguised as the bounty hunter [[Boushh]], who entered with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] as her prisoner. While the exterminator watched from beside the throne, Organa demanded double what Jabba was offering as the bounty for the Wookiee, and then threatened the Hutt and his court with a [[thermal detonator]] to get her way. While most of the court cowered, the Hutt merely laughed and counter offered with an increased, but not doubled amount. This satisfied Organa, who deactivated the detonator and let Chewbacca be led away.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The next day,<ref name="Darkside">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> Jabba and much of his court were killed by Organa and her allies above the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Wam Lufba had [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], yellow [[eye]]s, and fair skin.<ref name="ROTJ" /> He was perceived as innocuous by the rest of Jabba's court.<ref name="Force Collection" />

==Equipment==
Lufba used a [[blaster rifle]] and wore brown [[Clothing|shoes]].<ref name="USW" /> He also sometimes wore a pair of black shoes.<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:WamLufba-TheMakingOfReturnOfTheJedi.png|thumb|right|250px|The maquette of "Yuzzum"]]
The character of Wam Lufba was created for the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> A prototype model of the character, who was known during production as just "Yuzzum,"<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> was built for the film by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] and [[Judy Elkins]],<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> with Lufba's design being inspired by early concept art of the [[Ewok]] [[species]] which depicted them with much longer [[Limb|legs]].<ref name="Chronicles" /> A puppet of Lufba was then built for the film and was mounted onto the wall of the Jabba's Palace set<ref name="Creatures">''[[Classic Creatures: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> when the character's scene was filmed on Stage 8 at [[Elstree Studios]] between [[January 25]] and [[February 2]], [[1982]].<ref name="MakingOf" />

The Yuzzum was given a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] name and a backstory by [[Tim Veekhoven]], writing as "Sompeetalay," in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature [[What's The Story?]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|wamblamlufba|Lufba, Wam "Blam"}}</ref> The name, which was inspired by the [[Wikipedia:British|British]] [[Wikipedia:Pop music|pop band]] [[Wikipedia:Wham!|Wham!]]<ref name="blog">{{Blog|teekay-421|13|They were the chosen ones}}</ref> and parts of the backstory were then confirmed to be [[canon]] in the reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' released in [[2015]].<ref name="USW" />
